title: This is not a spoon - it's virtually flat.
text: This is not a spoon - it's virtually flat.. I don't know why they call this a spoonula.  It probably holds a half-teaspoon of liquid.  I have other spoonulas that you can actually use to serve some food from.  This is just a flat spatula with rounded sides.  It has no "bowl" to speak of.  Returned.
